title: DigestAlgorithm, TransferEncoding, KeyEncryptionAlgorithm lack Display
description: key.rs DigestAlgorithm, part.rs TransferEncoding, key.rs KeyEncryptionAlgorithm have Debug derives but no Display impl. These types appear in user-visible error messages (e.g. test code uses '{:?}' for DigestAlgorithm in UnsupportedAlgorithm errors). Debug output ('DigestAlgorithm::Sha256') is harder to read than a Display string ('sha-256'). A caller matching on SmimeError::UnsupportedAlgorithm or constructing an error string from a DigestAlgorithm value gets the Debug form, which leaks internal enum naming. Add Display for at least DigestAlgorithm since it's the type most likely to appear in end-user error messages.
